description: L2 source = v23 (v23 = HH2 combined alldata L2, v29 = NN mirror-flip per-source alldata L2). L3 = per-slot learned TinyMLP (hidden=32, dropout 0.2, AdamW lr=1e-2 wd=1e-3, 200 epochs w/ early stopping on 15% inner-val). Slot-by-slot fallback to ridge if learned CCC underperforms ridge CCC by > 0.05 (preserves no-regression guarantee). LOSO at L3 only; L2 trained on all 24 cohort subjects.
loso_discipline: Layer-3-LOSO-only (L2 trained on all 24 cohort subjects)

full_trial.feature_pool: 13 ROM-based features across all 5 metrics, computed across the full trial duration

event_anchored.feature_pool: 10 features anchored to detected DJ initial contact → pushoff window (typically 100-230ms)
event_anchored.event_detector: harness/dj_events.py (scipy peak-find on ankle vertical trajectory)

training_dataset.citation: Uhlrich et al. 2023, PLOS Comp Bio 19(10): e1011462
